newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Stamford Tyres results delayed by fire-TV.
newsitem.headline: Stamford Tyres results delayed by fire-TV.

text.p: Publication of Stamford Tyres Ltd's 1996/97 financial results will be delayed because of a fire at its premises, state television said on Monday.
The television evening news quoted company officials as saying the fire, at one of its three warehouses on June 20, had destroyed papers necessary for the preparation of its accounts.
The company said earlier in a statement it had been paid an interim sum of Singapore $5 million by its insurance company to cover fire damage.
Total losses were estimated at S$28 million. The company said it was fully insured.
